本许可不是独立入境通道，是在意大利境内由学习居留转换而来。时点跟着学习居留到期走: This is not a standalone entry route: it is converted from a study permit inside Italy, and the timing follows the expiry of that permit.
到就业中心登记 DID: Register the DID at the employment centre
在 Centro per l'Impiego 登记 dichiarazione: Register the dichiarazione di immediata disponibilità at the Centro per l’Impiego. This is a purpose requirement of the route, not an optional step.
买印花税票、填 kit 并邮寄: Buy the revenue stamp, fill in the kit and post it
在 tabaccheria 买 €16 印花税票，用邮局的 kit postal: Buy the €16 revenue stamp at a tabaccheria, submit through the post office kit postale, and pay the €30.46 card fee and the €30 post office fee. Whether the €40 surcharge is also charged depends on the local Questura.
按手印、等卡: Give fingerprints and wait for the card
按 Questura 预约时间到场采集指纹，之后等制卡。凭申请回执（ricevu: Attend at the Questura appointment time for fingerprinting, then wait for the card to be produced. During this period you may already work legally on the strength of the application receipt (ricevuta).
9–12 个月内找到工作并转工作居留: Find a job within 9–12 months and convert to a work permit
找到工作后按转换程序转成 lavoro subordinato 居留。Decre: Once you have a job, convert to a lavoro subordinato permit through the conversion procedure. Since Decreto Cutro this step is likewise outside the flussi quota and can be applied for all year.
法定区间 9–12 个月（具体时长由 Questura 按个案核定），不是可反复: The statutory range is 9–12 months (the Questura decides the actual length case by case); it is not a permit that can be renewed repeatedly. At expiry you must convert to a work or self-employment permit; if you do not, you lose your basis of stay.
本许可的核心用途是求职，不是工作许可。但 Decreto Cutro 带来一个关: The core purpose of this permit is job search, not work authorisation. Decreto Cutro did bring one key convenience: when converting to a work permit, **work may start on the strength of the application receipt** (the ricevuta carries interim work rights), without waiting for the card to be produced. This contrasts sharply with the equivalent Spanish route, which bans work entirely during the period.
必须先在就业中心登记 DID。没登记就缺少「求职中」这一目的要件，材料再全也不成: You must register the DID at the employment centre first. Without it the job-search purpose requirement is missing and the application fails however complete the documents are. This is the step most often missed.
费用口径有地区差异：€40 贡献金是否收取取决于 Questura。预算时按「可: The fees vary by office: whether the €40 surcharge is charged depends on the Questura. Budget for the possibility of the extra €40 rather than on the lowest figure.
法定时长是 9–12 个月的区间，不是固定值。实际给多久由 Questura 按: The statutory duration is a 9–12 month range, not a fixed figure. The Questura sets the actual length case by case, so when planning, work backwards from the 9-month minimum.
与「等 flussi 名额」的区别（重要）：常规工作签证要等每年按国籍分配的 f: The difference from waiting for a flussi place (important): the standard work visa waits for a flussi place allocated by nationality each year, and missing the window costs a year; after Decreto Cutro, conversion from study to work is **outside flussi** and can be applied for all year. Chinese-language sources often conflate the two, leading people to believe they still have to wait for a quota window after graduating.
与西班牙、法国、芬兰的对照：意大利这条在「转工作」环节最顺（凭回执即可上班），而: Against Spain, France and Finland: the Italian route is the smoothest at the conversion step (work can start on the receipt), whereas the equivalent Spanish permit bans work entirely during the period, France requires the job to match your studies and to clear a salary floor, and Finland grants an unrestricted right to work. The design of work rights differs widely across the four routes.
